name: Heroes IV-VII Memorial
description: Creatures, spells, abilities and adventure objects from Heroes of Might and Magic IV, V, VI and VII, as close to the originals as VCMI allows. Each generation is a submod that can be switched off on its own. Assets come from Heroes of Might and Magic IV, V, VI and VII (© Ubisoft), rendered and converted for VCMI by the author; some icons, portraits, map objects and battle effects were made or repainted with AI (OpenArt). Battering Ram script by Karyoplasma (batteringRam mod). Non-commercial fan-made mod, not affiliated with or endorsed by Ubisoft.

chinese.name: 英雄无敌4～7纪念版
chinese.description: 把《英雄无敌》4、5、6、7 代的兵种、魔法、能力和地图物件搬进 VCMI，尽量贴近原作。每一代是一个子 mod，可以单独关闭。素材来自《英雄无敌》4、5、6、7 代原版（© Ubisoft），由作者渲染转换为 VCMI 格式；部分图标、头像、地图物件和战斗特效用 AI（OpenArt）制作或在原画基础上重绘。攻城槌脚本来自 Karyoplasma 的 batteringRam mod。非商业同人作品，与 Ubisoft 无关。

author: yche2990

0.1.0: First release: Heroes IV, V, VI and VII memorial, Heroes VI dynasty weapons and guarded treasure chests.
